verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the GitHub integration: developers can mention @gemini-cli in issues and pull requests for task delegation, and it offers automated PR reviews and issue triage. That implies asynchronous work outside the local terminal, but the evidence never describes it as long-running work in an isolated cloud sandbox. Cloud Shell availability is an interactive hosted terminal, not background delegation. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented background or async agent mode, an isolated or sandboxed cloud execution environment, support for long-running task handling and monitoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
